test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The primary function of the flux during brazing is to _________.

options.text: increase the melting point of the spelter
make the joint more aesthetically pleasing
remove rust and prevent atmospheric effects

solution:
The correct answer is __remove rust and prevent atmospheric effects**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Flux__ is a chemical agent used during brazing to ensure proper bonding.
 
• Its primary function is to remove oxides that form on the metal surfaces during heating.
 
• By preventing oxidation, it ensures a clean and strong joint.
 
• Flux also helps to prevent atmospheric effects, such as contamination from moisture or air.
 
• This ensures the spelter flows properly and bonds the surfaces effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Options:**

 
 
• Option 1: Increasing the melting point of the spelter is incorrect; flux does not alter the melting point but ensures proper flow and bonding.
 
• Option 2: Making the joint aesthetically pleasing is not its primary function, though a clean joint may result.
 
• Option 4: Strengthening the joint is a result of its use but not the primary purpose.
